Counterfeit Cancer Drugs Found in Bengaluru Hospitals

Authorities have uncovered a suspected counterfeit cancer drug racket in Bengaluru, with reports indicating that spurious medicines may have reached as many as 90 hospitals. A chemist has been arrested in connection with the case, and investigations are underway to determine the full extent of the operation and how the fake drugs were distributed. The focus is on identifying the source of the counterfeit medications and the individuals involved in their supply chain. Hospitals across the city are reportedly under scanner as authorities work to ascertain if they received any of the suspect drugs.
